params.caption: 🎬 3 gaming stories in 36 seconds ✊ Rockstar Games staff voted against recognising the Rockstar Game Workers Union: 93.2% turnout, 75% against (Eurogamer) 📦 NielsenIQ: GTA 6 pushed UK boxed game sales up 409% vs the previous week, the biggest week since Christmas 2018, with no disc in the box (Eurogamer) 🤖 Ubisoft says projects are not required to use generative AI, after a Vertical Slice report said teams had to justify skipping it (GamesRadar+) 💬 Did you buy GTA 6 boxed? 🔔 @LevelUpGames0 #GamingNews
